candidates.snippet: 306: Proclaimed Emperor - Proclaimed emperor by his troops in Eboracum (modern York) following his father's death. 312: Battle of the Milvian Bridge - Defeated Maxentius near Rome, a pivotal victory attributed to divine intervention and leading to his sole rule in the West. 313: Edict of Milan - Issued the Edict of Milan with Licinius, granting religious tolerance throughout the Roman Empire, particularly for Christianity. 330: Founding of Constantinople - Dedicated Constantinople as the new capital of the Roman Empire, strategically located and heavily fortified.
